content.short: Blink Labs builds open-source Cardano infrastructure, node software, APIs, and developer tooling for builders.
content.description: Software and solutions for the Cardano blockchain. Pushing power to the edges. Building open-source technology for the future of decentralized global finance. Collaboration and community building is at the core of the Blink Labs culture. Bringing about the next generation of financial software will need to be a collaboration between an ever changing landscape of diverse parties each with their own thoughts and goals. Establishing open and honest communication empowers community participation which fosters personal accountability.
